note: This resolution records, per the frozen OPWS_POPULATION_BINDING_SCHEMA_R1 13-field schema and the static readiness audit (a117edae), the current resolvable candidates and the REQUIRED semantic mappings that remain ambiguous. No binding field is invented; no protocol semantic is changed.

full_d7_evidence_commit.schema_semantic: the Full-D7 frozen evidence commit that produced the READY census
full_d7_evidence_commit.reason: Schema semantic is the evidence commit that produced the OPWS READY census (M17 Q06/Q07 readiness artifacts). Those artifacts do not exist yet. Whether the scientific Full144 PASS evidence commit (0fea61c7) is accepted as the full_d7_evidence_commit is an owner decision.

full_d7_tag.reason: Same acceptance question as full_d7_evidence_commit (scientific PASS evidence tag vs future M17 READY-census evidence tag).

full_d7_ready_population_file.schema_semantic: path to the frozen Full-D7 READY population file
full_d7_ready_population_file.reason: The frozen I6 census exists and is authoritative (identity ce51d2ec). Whether it is accepted as the post-readiness READY population file (vs a future M17 Q07 ready-freeze file) is an owner decision.

full_d7_ready_population_sha256.schema_semantic: sha256 of the frozen Full-D7 READY population file
full_d7_ready_population_sha256.reason: Matches the static audit expected mapping (population_identity ce51d2ec -> full_d7_ready_population_sha256).

n_env_ready.candidate: 144 (all 144 scientific Full144 units PASS full environment resolution: install_rc=0, pipcheck_rc=0, native ok, import/pytest smoke ok, wt_is_dir=1)
n_env_ready.schema_semantic: number of environment-READY tasks in the frozen census
n_env_ready.reason: The OPWS eligibility funnel STAGE_4 defines ENV_READY via 'Full-D7 readiness records (negative + positive controls; READY decision) at final frozen census' (M17 Q06/Q07). The Full144 scientific run provides per-unit environment-resolution evidence but not the M17 readiness record format. Whether 144 is accepted as n_env_ready is an owner decision.

behavior_contract_manifest.schema_semantic: path to the frozen behavior-contract manifest (adapter + evaluator contract per task)
behavior_contract_manifest.reason: No frozen per-task behavior-contract manifest for the D7 tasks exists in the current worktree (adapter/E1/F2P per-task contract records are M17 Q02/Q03/Q05 artifacts that do not exist yet).

n_opws_eligible.reason: Requires the instantiated eligibility manifest (funnel STAGE_2 F2P evidence + STAGE_3 adapter + STAGE_5 behavior-executable), which the frozen funnel explicitly declares a 'LATER population-binding-era artifact'. Cannot be derived now without running the funnel (not authorized).

n_primary_paired.schema_semantic: number of PRIMARY_PAIRED_ELIGIBLE tasks (RM-CSS vs AGENT paired population)
n_primary_paired.reason: Prediction-artifact prerequisite is fully satisfied: all 219 D7 task IDs are covered by MAIN_297 (219/219), RM-CSS/SIP (219/219), AGENT (219/219), GOLD proxies (219/219). Exact PRIMARY_PAIRED_ELIGIBLE count requires the instantiated eligibility funnel (n_opws_eligible AND RM_CSS+AGENT+GOLD validity), which is a future binding-era artifact. Upper bound 219.

ordered_task_ids.candidate: 219 distinct D7 task IDs in frozen census order (ordered by unit order, deduplicated)
ordered_task_ids.schema_semantic: ordered, deduplicated, deterministic list of bound task IDs
ordered_task_ids.reason: List is derivable from the frozen census member_tasks in deterministic order. Serialization/hash semantic is ambiguous (see ordered_task_ids_sha256).

ordered_task_ids_sha256.schema_semantic: canonical sha256 of the ordered task-ID list
ordered_task_ids_sha256.reason: The static audit maps ordered_membership_hash 8eb4a724 (144-unit-ID hash) to ordered_task_ids_sha256, but the schema defines ordered_task_ids as the bound task-ID list (219 tasks). The compact sha256 of the 219-task list is 5972b20d..., which differs from 8eb4a724. Whether the canonical serialization is the 144-unit list or the 219-task list (and which JSON serialization) is a REQUIRED semantic mapping that is not resolved by any frozen artifact.

binding_created_at.schema_semantic: UTC ISO timestamp when the binding record is written (after Full D7 freeze)
binding_created_at.reason: Written only at binding time; not applicable now.

protocol_sha256.schema_semantic: sha256 of the released OPWS protocol freeze (tag peel hash at binding time)
protocol_sha256.reason: The protocol release tag exists and peels to 9038df3e. Note: git peel hashes are SHA-1 (40 hex), while the schema label says 'sha256'; the static audit expects the tag-peel hash. This notational looseness should be recorded in the binding record.

runtime_environment_binding_identity_and.reason: The static audit explicitly states 5169c69d 'is expected to map to opws_bound_population_hash OR the Full-D7 runtime environment binding consumed as environment_id / behavior_contract_manifest_sha256; the exact field assignment must be recorded in the binding record at Full-D7 freeze'. No frozen artifact resolves this mapping. REQUIRED SEMANTIC MAPPING AMBIGUOUS -> owner decision.

environment_id_dedup_identity.reason: OPWS_EXECUTION_REUSE_DEDUP_R1 5-tuple physical identity includes ENVIRONMENT_ID, but no frozen artifact defines environment_id for the D7/OPWS runtime (execution_image_ref? immutable_image_id? native_profile_id? binding hash?). REQUIRED SEMANTIC MAPPING AMBIGUOUS -> owner decision.

instantiated_eligibility_manifest.reason: OPWS_ELIGIBILITY_FUNNEL_R1 binding_note declares the instantiated per-task eligibility manifest (stage outcomes + reason codes) a 'LATER population-binding-era artifact'. Not present.

immutable_self_hashed_binding_record.reason: Binding schema binding_rules require the binding record to be self-hashed and stored immutably under mission artifacts at binding time.

verdict_reason: Multiple REQUIRED semantic mappings remain ambiguous per the frozen OPWS protocol/static-audit: (1) runtime/environment binding hash 5169c69d -> OPWS schema field (opws_bound_population_hash vs environment_id vs behavior_contract_manifest_sha256); (2) environment_id definition for the dedup 5-tuple; (3) ordered_task_ids_sha256 canonical serialization (144-unit hash 8eb4a724 vs 219-task hash 5972b20d); (4) acceptance of scientific Full144 PASS evidence as full_d7_evidence_commit/tag vs future M17 READY-census artifacts; (5) n_env_ready / n_opws_eligible / n_primary_paired require the not-yet-instantiated eligibility/readiness artifacts. No binding field mapping is invented.
